pages.title: Create a Keyword
pages.text: Definitions > Keywords opens a visual script with two action lanes: Periodic actions and Threshold actions. Settings includes name, max_stacks, duration, tick_interval, threshold, and consume_stacks. A keyword is custom state, not a registered potion effect.

pages.title: Periodic Actions
pages.text: While applied, tick_actions runs every tick_interval ticks. Twenty ticks is one second. Use damage with per_stack enabled to make a stacking damage-over-time effect. Particles can show its ongoing presence.

pages.title: Threshold Actions
pages.text: When stacks reach threshold, threshold_actions executes. consume_stacks removes exactly that threshold amount, keeping any remainder. Without consumption, it fires once when crossing from below and rearms after stacks fall below the threshold. A threshold cannot exceed max_stacks.

pages.title: Stacks and Duration
pages.text: max_stacks caps accumulation. duration is a single lifetime refreshed by new application. The system bounds duration and interval to 72,000 ticks, and stacks to 1,024. Resetting a field uses its documented runtime default.

pages.title: Reusable Templates
pages.text: mastery:scorch and mastery:thunder provide bundled examples, with matching mastery:scorch_on_hit and mastery:thunder_on_hit scripts. They remain inactive until a skill links a trigger. Copy their ideas into your own IDs for independent tuning.
